name: 課題一覧の情報行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH09-0001 課題一覧の情報行.
Reference hierarchy: Image1 ORIGINAL Linear source crop controls icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing, badge/control anatomy and missing details. Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY for Japanese content and overall layout; its rough substitute icons and omitted project badge must not be copied. Image3 is approved WHITE/FOREST-GREEN style ONLY, never copy bus content.
Render a compact single task row on pure white. Closely follow the original source icons: small three ascending priority bars; slim circular in-progress wedge icon (do not replace by a bold half-disc); fine dotted full circular assignee outline around a small person; original small document/project glyph inside the project pill. Match original optical sizes, strokes, baselines and column spacing. Restore the project's white outlined badge that our mock omitted, after the two category chips and before assignee.
Exact Japanese text left to right: 「作業-11」「利用者の声を整理する」 then category pills 「調査」「礼拝改善」 then project pill 「利用者の理解と行動分析…」 then assignee then 「4月1日」. The project label is a Japanese translation of the original's visibly truncated User Insight & Behavior Analytics Dashbo...; keep the ellipsis. No invented field or value. Preserve source information order.
Typography: Meiryo Regular 14/24 body, 12/16 metadata, zero tracking at 960px logical width. Regular title, not bold. Everything one line without clipping. Compact horizontal row approximately 960x44 logical pixels; tightly frame it if possible, no decorative empty padding. Only this single component, no extra row, table headings, footer, primary action, title or metrics.
Official style: pure white #FFFFFF canvas and white pills; fine neutral outlines, small rounded corners and very subtle elevation. Slate #526173 utility icons. Adapt original golden progress to brand green #1F6444, not yellow. Two category markers retain coherent green dots from Japanese adaptation. Project glyph remains slate. No mint chip fill. No random icon colors or broad green wash. Preserve original icon detail anatomy while restyling colors.
reviewNotes: 最新の原画像優先指示を適用。原画像切抜きを実入力として使い、日本語モックは補助。元のプロジェクトバッジを日本語で復元。日本語の全項目・日付を実見確認。進捗アイコンが細いウェッジではなく半円のまま、担当者アイコンの点線比率も原画像と異なる。上下の白余白過大が残る。二度の修正後も残るため要修正として保持し他の部品に進む。所有者承認・編集可能化・アプリ実装は未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
